arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && timeout 170 python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys, time, random
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from refmodel import py_build, py_validate, mask
rng = random.Random(4242)
routes = {}
while len(routes) < 8192:
    cls = rng.random()
    ln = rng.randrange(0, 17) if cls < 0.3 else (rng.randrange(17, 65) if cls < 0.6 else rng.randrange(65, 129))
    a = rng.randrange(1 << 128)
    k = (ln, mask(a, ln))
    if k not in routes:
        routes[k] = rng.randrange(0, 4194303)
t0 = time.time(); img = py_build(routes, rng); t1 = time.time()
print(f'py_build: {t1-t0:.1f}s')
t0 = time.time(); ok, got = py_validate(img); t1 = time.time()
print(f'py_validate: {t1-t0:.1f}s ok={ok} same={got==routes}')
import pickle
pickle.dump(routes, open('/workspace/tmp/big_routes.pkl','wb'))
EOF
